Paper Reproduction

Source: vignettes/reproducing-paper.Rmd
reproducing-paper.Rmd

The published paper is de Souza et al. (2025), “capivara: a spectral-based segmentation method for IFU data cubes”, MNRAS 539, 3166–3179, DOI 10.1093/mnras/staf688, arXiv 2410.21962.

Status

The repository contains the available real-data panels and research scripts. The original 2025 figure pipeline is not yet available as a single reproducible command. The Examples page shows the current MaNGA results.

Citation

Use the package citation:

citation("capivara")
